title: Peter Obi Reacts To Peace Accord Signing, Calls For Issues-Based Electoral Campaign
desc: The presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) for the 2027 presidential election, Peter Obi, has signed the first National Peace Accord for the 2027 Presidential Elections, reaffirming his commitment to a peaceful, issue-based and credible electoral process.
